title: Privacy Audit
description: On-TV process, microphone-device and network metadata inspection with an optional bounded local event log.
disableDescription: Stops periodic audit sampling. Existing RAM log entries are kept until cleared or the TV reboots. Privacy and microphone blocks are controlled by their separate modules.
publisher: Unknown Digital and Unknown Suite contributors
permissions: Runs as root; declarations are not a sandbox
Reads /proc and device metadata; optionally samples changes about once per minute
Retains only the last 128 sampled events in RAM; does not record voice audio or packet contents

status.title: View current status
status.description: Shows whether periodic recording is enabled and explains its sampling and retention limits. This is not a live activity snapshot.

health.title: Check module health
health.description: Reports recording configuration and availability. Use live inspections to observe activity; this health result is not proof that blockers work or tracking is absent.

maintenance.title: Reapply saved settings
maintenance.description: Takes one additional sample if recording is already enabled. It does not enable recording, add network blocks or change microphone access.

inspect.title: Inspect live device state
inspect.description: Takes a current snapshot of known service processes, capture devices and available network metadata. Short-lived activity between snapshots can be missed.

networkAudit.title: Inspect network and app indicators
networkAudit.description: Reads local connection and app indicators that may warrant investigation. It does not scan other devices or inspect packet contents; an indicator alone does not prove proxy abuse.

setRecording.title: Apply audit recording

enabled.title: Requested periodic audit recording
enabled.description: ON records sampled state changes locally. OFF stops adding samples but keeps existing entries. No microphone audio or network payloads are recorded.

setRecording.description: Changes whether Core samples observable metadata about once per minute. Only the last 128 events are kept in RAM; a reboot clears them.

viewLog.title: View audit log
viewLog.description: Displays retained sampled events. Missing events do not prove inactivity because this is a limited, periodic snapshot log.

clearLog.title: Clear audit log
clearLog.description: Deletes the retained audit events from RAM. Recording continues afterward if it is enabled.

confirmation.message: Confirm deleting the stored log entries. This cannot be undone.
